# photo-restore

> Fidelity-first photo restoration for AI agents: upscales and restores
> photographs without inventing people, and carries the archive metadata that
> makes a photograph findable in twenty years.

## About

- **Author:** Jesse Robbins — https://jesserobbins.com
- **Repository:** https://github.com/jesserobbins/photo-restore
- **Profile:** https://github.com/jesserobbins
- **License:** MIT
- **Version:** 2.1.0
- **Install:** `npx skills add jesserobbins/photo-restore`
- **Kind:** Agent Skill (a `SKILL.md` with instructions, plus verification scripts)

## What it is

An Agent Skill for restoring photographs with a generative image model while
protecting two things most restorations lose: the subject's identity, and the
photograph's metadata.

It is not an upscaler. It orchestrates whichever image model the agent has, states
what must not change, orders the corrections that are acceptable, and verifies the
result against the source.

## What it does

- States non-negotiable fidelity invariants: identity, facial geometry, expression,
  gaze, pose, body proportions, clothing, background, composition.
- Carries source metadata (capture date, camera, GPS, rating, keywords, caption,
  ICC profile) and verifies it against the real output pixels.
- Records provenance: when and where the upscale happened, written into
  `Software`, `CreatorTool`, `UserComment`, `XMP-xmpMM:History`, and appended to
  the caption and keywords. The capture date is never modified.
- Names outputs `<source-stem>_upscale.<ext>` and never overwrites.
- Scaffolds project directories with face and body references separated by role.
- Treats film grain as a disclosed decision, with the era used as a diagnostic for
  destroyed grain rather than a licence to invent texture.
- Round-trips results through Apple Photos with `osxphotos`, without modifying the
  library's originals.
- Builds a human review page: a slider per photo, callout crops of specific
  details, one verdict per photo, and an append-only verdict log the agent reads
  back.

## Key facts

- Preferred image models: those reachable through Gemini and Codex, used through
  their image-editing path.
- Requirements: Python 3.9+ with Pillow; `exiftool` for full metadata carry;
  ImageMagick or macOS `sips` for HEIC; `osxphotos` on macOS for the Photos round
  trip.
- Verification: 122 tests. Exit codes are part of the contract — 0 verified, 1
  verification failed, 2 nothing was written.
- Known limit: any Pillow re-encode of a 16-bit RGB TIFF yields 8-bit RGB.

## Quotable summary

photo-restore is an MIT-licensed Agent Skill by Jesse Robbins for restoring
photographs with AI image models. It preserves subject identity and the
photograph's EXIF metadata, records provenance in the file, and verifies both
before delivery. Install with `npx skills add jesserobbins/photo-restore`.
